title: Spec 015 Tenant current-main audit and authority convergence evidence

phases.objective: Validate immutable historical portfolio/candidate evidence and a separate exact-current-main semantic/authority reuse inventory without reconstructing candidates, creating duplicate persistence, or granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec 015 audit artifact regression and canonical authority convergence validator from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The immutable 2026-08-12 portfolio/candidate snapshot remains internally consistent, while the additive 2026-09-06 current-main authority matrix maps canonical concepts and field-level reuse against exact main SHA 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878 with T002/T003 evidence complete, T006/T008 owner decisions open, and no persistence/runtime/provider/Production authority granted.
steps: Parse the immutable 2026-08-12 reuse matrix and verify all legacy audit rows retain allowed statuses and evidence paths.
Parse the nine-record candidate PR snapshot and verify its own shared historical snapshot base SHA, read-only flags, and no secrets.

Parse the additive 2026-09-06 current-main authority matrix and verify package, component, installation, capability/operation, tool, Agent/Skill/Workflow, Activity Pack, MCP, Effective Runtime Manifest, and legacy Action semantic mappings.
Verify every current-main field mapping uses an allowed disposition: reuse_exact, reuse_with_extension, compatibility_only, projection_only, gap_requires_owner_decision, or retire_after_cutover.

Verify platform_private_packages, platform_package_versions, tenant_package_installs, canonical_capabilities, Growth Control Activity Packs, and SystemToolCatalogV2 are mandatory reuse evidence rather than silently duplicated authorities.
Verify copied installation grant/policy JSON is compatibility-only and immutable Installation Revision remains an owner-approved semantic gap.
Verify canonical Action is business work while Operation is the bounded callable primitive; legacy actions remain unresolved compatibility input for T006.
Verify T002/T003 are complete only as repository inventory/reuse evidence while T006/T008 remain open.
Run Spec 015 contract validation and the tenant audit regression without database, provider, Cloudflare, migration, or Production access.
assertions: The historical candidate snapshot and the current-main authority inventory are distinct evidence artifacts and need not share one SHA.
The current-main authority inventory is anchored exactly to 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878.
No wholesale solution_package_* persistence, new execution authority, or new permission authority is approved.
Tool visibility, Package references, Skills, Agents, Installation Revisions, Execution Capsules, Effective Runtime Manifests, and projections do not independently grant execution authority.
T002 and T003 are evidence-complete while T006 and T008 remain explicitly open.
Candidate convergence remains draft_review_required and reconstruct-on-current-main rather than blindly merged.
No database migration, provider write, Cloudflare change, Production mutation, candidate merge, or secret access is executed.
